titles.romaji: Kero Kero Keroppi no Ganbare! Keroppiis
titles.native: けろけろけろっぴのがんばれ! けろっぴーず

description: Kerropi and his friends are hectored when they have fun in the playground. Both of them agree to have a baseball competition. During the exercise, Junk quits the team because of their argument. Will they lose finally?
